provenance.rule: clmax_censored := (alpha[argmax(cl)] >= max(alpha)) over the COMBINED cruise+stall CONVERGED sweep (stall included iff its cached polar has >0 converged rows), i.e. the clmax is censored iff it sits at the last converged alpha. Matches aerobo.airfoil_select.polar_metrics (airfoil_select.py:480-502) as of Item 2. Sections with the cruise sweep below MIN_CONVERGED are True by definition (rule-independent).
